title: Test scenarios
description: One file per endpoint (API) or feature (UI) in <layer>/<area>/: a suite of scenarios. Key order inside a scenario: id, name, ref, status, automatedIn, role, knownIssue, steps.

tags.description: Tags for the whole suite: @<area> for UI (@cart), @<area>-api for API (@products-api). The spec's test.describe is titled '<tags joined by spaces> - <suite>'.

id.description: Unique scenario ID: <PREFIX>-<number>, numbered across the layer, with the prefix and digits from qa-agents-profile.yml (ids.layers), e.g. API-0001 or UI-001. The test title starts with it.

name.description: Scenario name (the test title after the ID).

ref.description: Optional link to what the scenario comes from: a user story, bug or document (US-123, BUG-45, docs/ui/user-stories/Product_Detail.md#AC3), or a list of them.

status.description: manual (the default for a new scenario) or automated (set together with automatedIn when a spec automates it).

automatedIn.description: Path of the spec that automates this scenario. Required when status is automated, absent when it's manual.

role.description: Login role of the test. Absent means the default user.

knownIssue.description: A known app bug this scenario hits; becomes the test's 'Known issue' annotation.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Checks are steps that start with 'Verify'.
